intro: Water Sapta is a transitional task bestowed upon young Horde shaman by Islen Waterseer along the coast of the Barrens. Imbued with a ritual brew, the shaman is sent across the Great Sea to the blighted lands of Silverpine Forest to face a corrupted spring.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take the water sapta and find the corrupted pool of water in Silverpine, friend. I have great faith in your abilities.
